benchmark.dependencyPolicy: BONUS fallback excluded while CZ primary is available; small roles evaluated as one multinomial joint likelihood
benchmark.exposureAssumption: benchmark N games means N observed normal-game trials for CZ and N observed games for small-role joint. Runtime confidence remains separate.

simulation.method: Seeded Monte Carlo likelihood classification from v8 dependency-safe selected features
simulation.featureConstruction: FEAT_CZ_INITIAL binomial + FEAT_SMALL_ROLE_JOINT multinomial reconstructed from Selection dependency contract

notes: Settings 3–4 are excluded from this benchmark by Manifest definition.
Evidence constraints are not included in HighLowDiscrimination.
This benchmark is setting-group discrimination reference information, not runtime 判定信頼度.

Previous benchmark values were replaced after the v8 reproducibility gate exposed that their exact generating path was not reproducible from the saved upstream contracts. These values are the deterministic seeded result of the checked-in calculator and dependency-safe Selection contract.
